aliases: 3MP Outdoor Wi-Fi Pan & Tilt Network Camera
features: outdoor motorized pan & tilt (Pan 0-350, Tilt 0-90) with auto-tracking
smart dual light: 30 m IR + 30 m warm light color night vision
sound and light alarm active deterrence
AI human and vehicle detection, abnormal sound alarm
Wi-Fi (IEEE 802.11b/g/n/ax 2.4 GHz) + RJ-45 ethernet + Bluetooth pairing
lens options: 2.8 mm or 3.6 mm fixed-focal
two-way talk, microSD up to 256 GB, DMSS app
release_notes: The Dahua P3I-PV is a 3MP outdoor mains-powered Wi-Fi pan & tilt camera with auto-tracking, smart dual-light color night vision, AI human/vehicle detection and sound-and-light active deterrence. Verified against the official Dahua product page.

home_assistant.notes: Consumer Wi-Fi camera managed via the DMSS app; ONVIF/RTSP not stated on the datasheet. Add via the Generic Camera integration only if a stream is exposed.

blue_iris.notes: Select the 'Dahua' profile; RTSP is not confirmed on the datasheet.
